condition: Reading NDJSON with a schema or schema_overrides that declares a top-level column as Int8/Int16/UInt8/UInt16/Time/Duration panics with "unexpected dtype when deserializing ndjson" when the column has non-null values.
workaround: Read the column as Int64 (or another supported type) in the schema, then cast it to the narrower type afterwards with .cast().
